howToRedeem: There is no code box inside the game (removed in Dec 2020). Codes are redeemed on Lilith's web portal.
In AFK Arena, tap your avatar (top-left) and copy your UID, the number shown under your player name. Classic and Companions accounts have different UIDs.
In the same avatar panel, open Settings (gear icon) and tap 'Verification Code' to generate a 6-digit code. It is single-use and expires after about 2 minutes, so generate it right before logging in.
Open https://cdkey.lilith.com/afk-global in a browser, enter the UID and verification code, and tap Log In. Some guides say a linked account can log in with email and password instead.
Choose the server that matches the code (Classic or Companions). Codes only work on their own server.
Enter the code exactly as listed and tap Redeem. Each code works once per UID.
Back in the game, open Mail (envelope icon) and tap Claim All.

webRedeem.notes: This official Lilith portal is the only way to redeem. Log in with your in-game UID plus a 6-digit verification code from avatar > Settings > Verification Code (expires after about 2 minutes). Then pick Classic or Companions and enter the code. Rewards arrive by in-game mail. Each code works once per UID or server, and the official posts say the same code can be used again on a different server. Sources disagree on case-sensitivity: Dexerto and AllThings.how say codes are not case-sensitive, while BoostBot and games.gg say they are. Paste the code exactly as written.

cadence: Lilith posts AFK Arena codes in pairs, one for Classic and one for Companions, on the official X, Facebook and Discord channels. Releases follow events, holidays and collabs: AFK anniversary (April), Labor Day (May 1), Lilith 13th anniversary (May 9), Kaiju No. 8 collab (Sep 23), Mid-Autumn (Sep 25), early October (Oct 1). In 2026 that worked out to about 1-3 new pairs a month: June 3, 19, 24 and 30; July 2 and 30; Aug 19; Sep 3, 23 and 25; Oct 1. Codes usually last 4-10 weeks and tend to expire at month-end (00:00 UTC+8), so checking every couple of weeks catches them all.

uncertain: Every page fetch (WebFetch and curl) was blocked by DNS or the proxy, so all data comes from search-engine snippets and summaries, not the pages themselves. None of the codes were test-redeemed.
No source published reward contents for the 8 active codes (8VI6VSBQGE, 8V5257RADA, 8vtsewmeyj, 8vn8gamxqy, 8D82CDSRBY, 8DM4I4AWUE, 7TUZ4QI7CQ, 7TT7TZHW8X). They are only described as 'free rewards'.
Server assignment for 8D82CDSRBY and 8DM4I4AWUE is swapped on Dudcode compared with BoostBot, LOLVVV and MrGuider. The majority mapping is used here (8D82... Classic, 8DM4... Companions).
The added date for 8VI6VSBQGE and 8V5257RADA differs between sources: 2026-10-01 (MrGuider) and 2026-10-16 (LOLVVV).

The official Mid-Autumn X post (2026-09-25, valid until 2026-11-30) was found, but its snippet did not show the code strings. Linking it to 8vtsewmeyj and 8vn8gamxqy rests on the matching date and expiry only.
7BH6PUM7YN and 7BZV7M9B38: BoostBot's text says 'live now, checked Oct 20' but its table and MrGuider say they expired on 2026-09-30. They are marked expired here.
Case-sensitivity is disputed between sources. Codes are recorded as most sources print them.

Many large sites (Pocket Tactics Oct 7, Dexerto, PocketGamer, Gaming Deputy) still list codes from Dec 2025 to May 2026 as active even though their official expiry has passed. Treat those lists as stale.
Lordstrategist lists a code 'HALLOWEEN' with no date or rewards. It was not found anywhere else and is excluded as unreliable. No 2026 Halloween code was found as of 2026-10-26.
No Reddit r/afkarena or Discord posts came up in search, and Reddit could not be reached directly.
